stream_types.PLANT: Brownian streams for physical core, mediator, hidden/common-driver and environment. For registered paired comparisons pair_group is shared across compared generator/access conditions.
stream_types.MEASUREMENT: Observation noise. pair_group includes access label so measurement noise is independent across A1 high/mid/low.
stream_types.H3_TARGET: Independent target-side stochastic measurements for H3. Must never reuse FEATURE seeds.

pair_groups.H1_G0_A1: same PLANT seed across a_high/a_mid/a_low; separate MEASUREMENT seeds
pair_groups.H2_G0_G7: same PLANT seed for G0/G7 except registered parameter perturbation
pair_groups.H2_G0_G8: same PLANT seed for G0/G8 except registered parameter perturbation
pair_groups.H2_G0_G9: same PLANT seed for G0/G9; observation transduction differs by registration
pair_groups.H4_G4_G5: same exogenous/core/mediator PLANT components; G5 additionally has hidden-h component
pair_groups.H5_G0_G6_A0: same physical-core/environment PLANT components and the same single mediator innovation component used by G0 b and both G6 zV/zO
pair_groups.H5_G0_G6_A2: same paired PLANT components; structural difference arises only from mediator multiplicity/positions under the common spatial field
pair_groups.HV_G0_G8: same PLANT components for viability-targeted contrast
pair_groups.HI_G0_G7: same PLANT components for influence-targeted contrast

invariants: PLANT paired seeds must not include generator or access names outside pair_group.
MEASUREMENT seeds must include access identity.
FEATURE and H3_TARGET stream_type values must produce disjoint seeds for every master/replicate/component.
All master index ranges are disjoint.
No legacy PH seed is imported or reused.
